name: v0.3.43 — Costco membership autofill, new scan animation, random login mascot
releaseNotes:
• Receipts: the membership / loyalty number now auto-fills the Reward No field when you scan (Costco “Member”, Giant “Customer”, etc.) — previously it was read on the server but dropped before the form.
• Receipts: a full-screen scan animation now plays while a photographed OR dictated receipt is read — the maracas avocado + a sweeping magnifier + an animated status bubble (Looking for the store… → Saving to your Stash 🥑).
• Receipts: capture options are collapsed behind a single floating “+ Add” button (Take a photo / Pick from gallery / Voice).
• Login: a random avocado greets you each time — the Mexican maracas dancer, the sombrero avocado, or the happy / rich / relaxing moods.
